summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of DataKat landing page across 1440x900, 1280x800, 1366x768, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844, 360x800, and reduced-motion. All five post-hero chapters render in order, hero video plays and section is 220vh, nav anchors work, product demo advances through states with pause/resume/show-answer, workbench question switching updates answer/charts/access-context/answer-receipt and persists trace phase, controlled access scenarios (authorized/mismatch) behave correctly including mid-playback scenario change and gate-detail selection, closing CTAs route to /signup and /login, mobile responsive with no horizontal overflow and >=44px tap targets, keyboard Tab/Space activation works, sticky process has correct wrapper height (2880 = 4*720), stage switching at ~0.25/0.5/0.75 progress, reverse scrolling, rail nav focus retention, and skip-process link focusing #workbench-heading. Reduced-motion: hero video still plays, 'View example steps' replaces Watch button, motion toggles disabled with 'Motion off' label, process uses rows. One copy-level spec deviation: the string 'certification' appears in body text (spec forbade substring 'certif'). Third-party emergent-main.js emits a React dev warning about `defaultMuted` prop and a GSAP container warning; these originate from the Emergent badge script bundle, not from DataKat code.

ui_bugs.issue: Body text contains the substring 'certif' in the sentence 'it is not a certification.' Spec requires NO occurrence of 'certif' anywhere on the page.

action_items: Rephrase the ControlledAccess disclaimer to remove the word 'certification' (e.g. 'it is not an audit result' or 'it is not a compliance claim') to comply with the forbidden-terms list.

(Informational, not DataKat code) The injected Emergent badge script `assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js` logs a React DEV warning about an unknown `defaultMuted` prop and a GSAP ScrollTrigger non-static-position warning. These do not originate from app source and can be ignored, but they add console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements expose correct data-testid, aria-pressed, and aria-current attributes.
Timings and state transitions in the 16s GSAP demo match the spec; Pause truly freezes state; Show answer jumps to state 6.
Process sticky eligibility correctly gates at 1280x800+; wrapper height formula produces 2880px at 1440x900 as expected.
Reduced-motion correctly disables Watch, Motion toggles, and sticky scrubbing while preserving the hero video.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero is 220vh and MUST remain untouched. Lenis smooth-scroll means always wait ~600-900ms after scrollIntoView/scrollTo. Process sticky only mounts at viewport >=1280x800; at 1366x768 it falls back to rows. Console warnings from assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js are third-party; filter them out. The only functional/copy deviation found was the word 'certification' in ControlledAccess body copy.
rca of the issue: Forbidden substring 'certif' is present because the ControlledAccess chapter uses the phrase 'it is not a certification' to disclaim compliance semantics. Reproduce: document.body.innerText.includes('certif') === true at /. Mitigation: edit /app/frontend/src/post-hero/ControlledAccess.jsx (or associated copy source) to replace 'certification' with a synonym such as 'compliance claim' or 'audit result'.
